name: UK Cyber Security Code of Practice for AI
official_reference: DSIT / NCSC Guidelines for Secure AI System Development
description: UK Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT) and NCSC guidelines for developers, providers, and deployers of systems using AI, structured across Secure Design, Secure Development, Secure Deployment, and Secure Operation.

requirements.title: Secure Design — Raise AI Threat Awareness and Model Risks
requirements.normalized_requirement: Understand AI-specific risks, establish AI system threat models, and assess trade-offs between model functionality, performance, and security posture.
requirements.implementation_guidance: Incorporate AI threat modeling into the design phase of all machine learning initiatives.

requirements.title: Secure Deployment — Protect Infrastructure and Secure Prompt Interfaces
requirements.normalized_requirement: Protect deployment environments, secure external APIs, sanitize user inputs, and protect model weights and intellectual property from unauthorized extraction.
requirements.implementation_guidance: Enforce network isolation, API gateways, rate limiting, and output validation.
